name: Wadley Farms
description: A historic family farm venue (since 1869) on 23 acres in Lindon with a castle, an event barn, a historic railroad building, gardens, vineyards, orchards and on-site lodging, offering indoor and outdoor settings.
priceText: Barn & Railroad winter $3,100 to Castle Fri–Sat $7,200
standingText:

Barn: 250 open-flow (space description says 300 for an open house)

items.label: Description
items.value: A historic family farm venue (since 1869) on 23 acres in Lindon with a castle, an event barn, a historic railroad building, gardens, vineyards, orchards and on-site lodging, offering indoor and outdoor settings.

items.label: Price
items.value: Barn & Railroad winter $3,100 to Castle Fri–Sat $7,200

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
The Castle, 2pm-10pm year-round: Mon-Wed — $5,600; Thu — $6,000; Fri-Sat — $7,200
The Barn & Railroad Building, summer (Apr-Sep) 2pm-10pm: Mon-Wed — $4,800; Thu — $5,200; Fri-Sat — $5,600
The Barn & Railroad Building, winter (Oct-Mar) 2pm-10pm: Mon-Thu — $3,100; Fri-Sat — $3,600
Rentals generally include tables, chairs, linens and setup, plus exclusive use of the rented building (and its surrounding gardens Apr-Sep)
Premium Estate Package: Castle and Barn, two nights of on-site lodging, private dinner the evening before — starting at $17,500
Ceremony add-on (any venue) — $350
Full-day 10am-10pm rentals available (price on request)

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Castle — $2,000 non-refundable
Barn & Railroad Building — $1,500 non-refundable
Signed contract required to reserve

items.label: Standing
items.value:
Castle: 350 open-flow
Barn: 250 open-flow (space description says 300 for an open house)
Railroad Building with garden: 300 open house

items.label: The Castle
items.value: Seated: 200 · Standing: 350 · Setting: indoor + gardens Apr-Sep · Features: 4,500 sq ft Great Hall; 38-ft fireplace; bride's and groom's dressing rooms; up to 4 breakout rooms; sound system; LCD projector + 18-ft screen; full-service kitchen · Catering: recommended caterers only

items.label: The Barn
items.value: Seated: 100 · Standing: 250 open-flow (300 open house per space page) · Setting: indoor + gardens Apr-Sep · Features: grand chandelier; two fireplaces; wrought-iron balcony · Catering: any caterer or self-cater

items.label: The Railroad Building
items.value: Seated: 40 · Standing: 100 for an indoor ceremony; 300 with garden for an open house · Setting: indoor + garden Apr-Sep · Features: fireplace; French doors to garden · Catering: any caterer or self-cater · Note: Rented together with the Barn

items.label: Rain plan
items.value: Indoor Great Hall or Barn; outdoor ceremonies weather-dependent and typically not held Oct-Mar

items.label: Rooms
items.value:
Castle bride's dressing room (with balcony)
Castle groom's dressing room

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Tables
Chairs
Linens
Castle Great Hall 38-ft fireplace and upper-chamber fireplace
Barn grand chandelier and two fireplaces
Railroad Building fireplace
Castle iron chandeliers
Castle grand staircases
Barn wrought-iron balcony
Vine-wrapped gazebo (ceremony backdrop)
Gardens, vineyards and orchards (Apr-Sep with rental)
Bistro lights along garden paths and castle terrace

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
Castle coordinator and Barn & Railroad Building coordinator on staff
Lead hostess on staff

items.label: Projector
items.value: LCD projector and an 18 ft drop down screen

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Professional sound system in the Castle
LCD projector and 18-ft drop-down screen in the Castle

items.label: String / bistro lights
items.value: Bistro lights on the stone patio and walkway

items.label: For rent
items.value:
6-ft wooden tables — $100 each
Crossback chairs — $8 each
Lighting in the Castle — $1,000

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Three on-site lodging rentals (Rustic Loft, Chateau, Hermitage), booked separately
Ceremony add-on — $350
Shuttle service (price on request)
High-speed Wi-Fi in the Castle
Photo sessions on the grounds complimentary for booked clients

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Castle: caterer must be from the venue's recommended list
Barn & Railroad Building: any caterer or self-catering allowed

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Castle: full-service kitchen
Barn & Railroad Building: kitchen for keeping food warm or cool

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Beer and wine only, served by a licensed bartender
$1,000 alcohol privilege fee
COPA bartenders listed as the required vendor for serving alcohol

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes
Sparkler exits allowed; other fireworks not permitted

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon-Sat 2pm-10pm
Mon-Sat 10am-10pm full-day option
A la carte hours on request

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Outdoor ceremonies weather-dependent; typically not scheduled Oct-Mar
Alcohol limited to beer and wine
Castle requires a caterer from the recommended list
No fireworks other than sparklers
No pets (service animals welcome)
No gatherings or getting-ready groups in the lodging unless part of a package

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Family farm since 1869; 23 acres
Exclusive use of the rented building; its surrounding gardens are included Apr-Sep
Castle: 4,500 sq ft Great Hall and up to four breakout rooms
Lodging has a two-night minimum

items.label: Policies
items.value: two-night minimum; check-in after 3pm, check-out 11am; no gatherings or getting-ready groups unless part of a package; 50% deposit
